comment.body: Engineering investigation needed: Customer in observability beta reports no metrics visible on dashboards after upgrade. Launch review scheduled Friday; root cause and workaround identification needed urgently.

Thank you for reaching out. Our engineering team is investigating the issue with metrics not showing on dashboards after your upgrade. We understand the urgency ahead of your launch review, and will provide updates as soon as possible.

reply:
I triaged the open inbox according to the team triage plan:

- For the observability-beta incident ("Observability beta: dashboards show no metrics since upgrade"):
  - Set the ticket priority to urgent and added the "obs-beta" tag, preserving existing tags.
  - Added a private note for engineering stating the customer in the beta is missing all metrics after upgrade, with a launch review scheduled Friday.
  - Posted a public acknowledgment to the customer informing them the team is investigating.

No actions were taken on P0 non-beta or other unrelated tickets per the team plan. All other tickets remain unchanged. Work completed as required by team policy.
